channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Brasil escolhe hoje entre o retorno de um Bolsonaro e o 4º mandato de Lula
item.description: Over 158 million eligible Brazilian voters choose today between the return of Jair Bolsonaro to power and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government continuing for another four years. The 2026 election unfolds amid national polarization, with key debates centered on economy, security, and corruption. The campaign was marked by mutual criticism and promises of structural reforms.

item.title: Lula x Flávio nas novas pesquisas de segundo turno: veja números atualizados
item.description: Six institutes released polls for the runoff election between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with tight margins. The race remains competitive between the two candidates.

item.title: Datafolha, Quaest, Palver, BTG/Nexus, Atlas: veja últimas pesquisas do segundo turno
item.description: Datafolha, Quaest, Palver, BTG/Nexus and AtlasIntel/Bloomberg polls measure the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with margins of error ranging from 1 to 2.2 points.

item.title: Um herdeiro de clã em constante provação: Flávio Bolsonaro supera desconfiança sob o desafio de aplacar divisões
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his presidential candidacy during a meeting at the traditional A Bela Sintra restaurant in São Paulo. As a clan heir under constant scrutiny, he faces the challenge of overcoming distrust and bridging divisions within his political base.

item.title: Zebras fora do radar: pesquisas indicam chances baixas de viradas nos estados com segundo turno
item.description: Surveys released before the second round of state elections show low chances of upsets, with candidates leading in the first round maintaining their advantages. Flávio Bolsonaro and Celina Leão lead in their respective races, while Omar Aziz and Lorenzo Pazolini also hold wide margins over opponents.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro? Segurança, economia e rejeição ao PT dão o tom entre eleitores do senador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads polling with proposals on security, economy and anti-PT rhetoric, backed by voters who reject Lula and value family, religion and the legacy of his father Jair.

item.title: Máquina garante voto? Tempo de TV muda tudo? A polarização cansou? As máximas eleitorais colocadas em xeque em 2026
item.description: The 2026 electoral results challenged traditional assumptions, such as the influence of the public machine, party alliances, and polarization fatigue. Personalist candidates and targeted campaigns won over broader coalitions, questioning long-held beliefs about alliances and TV exposure. The election also highlighted the use of AI for misinformation and voter volatility.

item.title: Ajuste fiscal, juros, produtividade, IA: a longa lista de desafios econômicos no horizonte do próximo presidente
item.description: The economy will be a central challenge for the next president, regardless of whether Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro wins. The victor will need to address financial sector pressure for fiscal adjustments and a challenging macroeconomic environment both domestically and internationally.

item.title: Com 51% a 49% no Datafolha e na Quaest, Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula chegam à eleição com a menor diferença em 20 anos
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in polls, marking the smallest electoral gap in 20 years. The pro-Lula wave did not consolidate, and polling projections favor Flávio. Lula's administration has finally surpassed disapproval rates.

item.title: Lulinha, Supremo, 'Dark horse': a cronologia da corrida presidencial em oito pontos
item.description: The 2026 election race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) concluded after a campaign marked by a crisis at the STF and the 'Dark Horse' scandal. Lula leads among the poorest (58%) and Flávio, among the wealthy (57%), according to Quaest.

item.title: A última dança por uma virada inédita: surpreendido no primeiro turno, Lula ressurge aprendendo com as ruas e as redes
item.description: In the 1982 election, Lula was polling third place on the eve of his bid for São Paulo governor, despite captivating crowds and performing well in TV debates. The article captures his exhaustion and confidence ahead of an unexpected outcome.

item.title: Seja Flávio ou Lula: do Supremo ao Congresso, presidente eleito terá de lidar com tensão elevada entre Poderes
item.description: The 2026 election between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will intensify tensions among the Powers, with distinct governance strategies. Lula seeks to reorganize his base and negotiate with Centrão, while Flávio relies on parliamentary majority and pressure on the STF. Both face challenges in implementing their agendas amid polarization and institutional conflicts.

item.title: Eleição histórica que chega ao fim hoje dará poder inédito a uma única família ou terá a primeira virada já registrada
item.description: The tenth presidential election since the return to democracy is decided today between Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. If Flávio wins, three members of the Bolsonaro family will hold simultaneous offices in Congress. If Lula wins, it will mark the first historical comeback after trailing in the first round.

item.title: Após peso inédito na campanha, política externa colocará o novo presidente entre o pragmatismo e a afinidade ideológica
item.description: Foreign policy has become a central theme in the 2026 presidential race, driven by Donald Trump's tariffs and U.S. interference supporting Flávio Bolsonaro. The contest between Lula and the far-right involves balancing pragmatism and ideological alignment amid tariff pressures and calls for Jair Bolsonaro's pardon.

item.title: Por que Lula? Proteção social, meio ambiente e soberania norteiam eleitores do petista
item.description: Lula's voters highlight social protection, environmental defense, and sovereignty as voting reasons, recalling programs like Bolsa Família and SUS strengthening. The campaign emphasizes environmental preservation and national sovereignty against foreign interests. For some, the vote reflects more rejection of the Bolsonaro family than support for the government.

item.title: Sob a missão dos generais: como canais do WhatsApp mobilizaram os eleitores de Flávio e Lula no segundo turno
item.description: WhatsApp channels like 'Exército do Lula' and 'Tropa do Flávio' mobilized voters in the runoff, shaping the digital strategy of the campaigns. The PT channel reached 10.8 million followers, while the PL channel had 2.1 million, underscoring the role of social media in guiding grassroots activism and voter engagement.

item.title: Posso ir votar de bermuda? Veja o que é proibido nas eleições
item.description: In the 2026 elections, there is no legal prohibition on clothing for voting, but beachwear such as bikinis or thongs should be avoided by common sense. It is allowed to show personal preference with flags or brooches, but it is prohibited to promote gatherings, carry out collective propaganda, or bring phones and devices inside the voting booth. Practices such as approaching voters, distributing gifts, or carrying weapons are also forbidden, subject to penalties.

item.title: Pesquisa PoderData/Aya: leia os resultados de Lula e Flávio no 2º turno
item.description: A PoderData/Aya survey released on October 25, 2026 shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 51% and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) with 49% of valid votes in the second round. Both voting intentions match the previous survey from October 22, with a margin of error of 1.6 percentage points.

item.title: Mulheres e pardos: o perfil dos 2,2 milhões de eleitores do DF no 2º turno
item.description: In the 2026 second-round elections in the Federal District, 2,253,732 eligible voters will participate, with female (54%) and brown (49.17%) majorities. Approximately 426,000 voters abstained in the first round, and 273,434 voter registrations are canceled. Key races include Celina Leão vs. Leandro Grass for governor and Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro for president.

item.title: Lula vence Flávio na Nova Zelândia; acompanhe votação no exterior
item.description: In the 2026 overseas elections, 918,876 Brazilians voted. In the first round, Lula won 64 countries and Flávio 37, but Flávio led with 47.03% against Lula's 45.16%. In New Zealand, Lula secured 80.54% in the second round.

item.title: Saiba como estão Lula e Flávio nas últimas 18 pesquisas divulgadas
item.description: The 18 most recent national polls for the 2026 runoff show Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) ahead of President Lula da Silva (PT) in 17 of them, with 1 tie and none indicating a win for Lula. The polls, conducted between October 12 and 24, consider only valid votes, excluding blanks, nulls, and undecideds.

item.title: Trunfo de Lula, jovens são os que menos pretendem votar no 2º turno
item.description: A survey conducted by DataFolha on October 23-24, 2026 shows that young people aged 16 to 24 are the least likely to confirm their intention to vote in the presidential runoff. Although Lula leads with 53% against 42% in this age group, lower turnout intentions may hinder translating this support into actual votes. Older voters show higher voting likelihood and lean toward Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Eleitores de Flávio estão mais decididos do que os de Lula
item.description: PoderData/Aya survey reveals that 95% of voters have already decided their vote for the second round, with 98% of Bolsonaro supporters, 93% of Lula supporters, and 5% still undecided. The poll shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (51%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (49%), with a margin of error of 1.6 percentage points, considering only valid votes.

item.title: Saiba como estão Vicentinho e Dorinha nas pesquisas para governador do TO
item.description: The four most recent polls for the second round of the Tocantins gubernatorial election, conducted between October 15 and 24, 2026, show Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) leading numerically over Professor Dorinha (União Brasil). Vote intentions were calculated based on valid votes, excluding undecided and blank/null responses, and account for varying methodologies and margins of error across polling firms. Poder360 emphasizes that the results do not constitute official projection of the October 25 election.

item.title: Onde Flávio abriu 588 mil votos e Lula tenta reagir em Minas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 elections in Minas Gerais, registering 588,612 more votes in the first round. Lula intensified campaigning in the state, where he narrowly defeated Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, while Flávio won in nine of the ten largest electoral colleges.

item.title: Só 11% dizem que não votaram no 1º turno, mas abstenção foi de 21,08%
item.description: A PoderData/Aya survey released after the first round of Brazil's 2026 general election found only 11% of respondents said they did not vote, despite an official abstention rate of 21.08%. The first-round abstention was the highest since 1998, and experts note historical difficulties in accurately estimating voter turnout through polls. In the second round, voter demotivation and the absence of state-level races may increase abstention, but reducing turnout alone would not be enough to change the outcome of the presidential race between Flávio and Lula.

item.title: Saiba como estão Cadu de Lula e Allyson nas pesquisas do RN
item.description: The six most recent polls for the second round of elections in Rio Grande do Norte show Allyson Bezerra (União Brasil) leading Cadu de Lula (PT) numerically in four surveys, while the PT candidate leads in two. The polls were compiled by Poder360 based on interviews conducted between October 13 and 24, 2026.

item.title: Brasil decide entregar todo el poder a los Bolsonaro o dar una última oportunidad a Lula
item.description: Brazilians from left and right-wing movements mass-mobilize ahead of highly contested presidential elections with nearly 160 million voters choosing between two opposing political models this Sunday.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Nova Zelândia encerra período de votação no segundo turno
item.description: The voting period for Brazilian residents in New Zealand in the 2026 presidential election runoff concluded at 01:00 on Sunday, Brasília time. The race remains between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Recent polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 50.6% against Lula's 49.4%.

item.title: La cuna del lulismo mantiene la llama y la esperanza: “¡Aquí no hay miedo!”
item.description: The article tells the story of Doña Célia, 80, who runs a bar and store near the Metal Workers Union headquarters in São Bernardo do Campo, where Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva began his political journey. It highlights the contrast between Lula's humble beginnings and his path to the presidency, keeping the inspiration alive among workers.

item.title: Brasil decide este domingo si seguirá siendo una democracia
item.description: Brazil decides this Sunday the direction of its democracy in the presidential runoff, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied in the polls. A Lula victory may contain the threat to democracy, but the far right already dominates Congress; a Bolsonaro win risks undermining institutions and the rule of law.

item.title: 🔴 ELEIÇÕES 2026: NOVA PESQUISA AGITA A DISPUTA ENTRE FLÁVIO E LULA!
item.description: A new opinion poll shakes up the 2026 race, heightening competitiveness between Flávio Dino and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The survey, commissioned by business groups and media outlets, indicates a tight duel between the two leaders in voting intentions. The release reinforces scenario uncertainty and the intensification of party alliances and political maneuvering.

item.title: O ritual mais sagrado da democracia
item.description: Over 158 million Brazilians are expected to vote in the 2026 municipal elections, with a balanced race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Voting is emphasized as democracy's most sacred ritual, underscoring the electoral process's role in determining the country's future.

item.title: Votação no exterior: Lula vence Flávio Bolsonaro na Nova Zelândia; acompanhe
item.description: Lula defeats Flávio Bolsonaro in New Zealand in the overseas vote, expanding his global lead in the second round. Of Brazilians abroad, Lula leads in 64 countries while Flávio appears in 36, with final results expected after 5 PM BRT.

item.title: Eleições 2026: qual é a ordem de votação no segundo turno?
item.description: In the 2026 runoff election, the voting order at the electronic ballot box varies by state or municipality. In states with a gubernatorial race, such as Acre, Amazonas, Federal District, Rio Grande do Norte, Espírito Santo, and Tocantins, the vote for governor comes before the presidential vote. In other regions without a gubernatorial runoff, supplementary election, or plebiscite, voters cast their ballots only for president.

item.title: Flávio repete afirmação falsa sobre mesários votarem no lugar de eleitores ausentes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro repeated a false claim about poll workers voting in place of absent voters during a live broadcast. The statement was made in a video for followers on Saturday (24), the eve of the runoff election.

item.title: Brasil do Povo (24/10/26) | Completo
item.description: The October 24, 2026 episode of 'Brasil do Povo', hosted by Katiuzia Rios, covers news and journalistic debates on national topics. The content reflects RedeTV!'s typical coverage, focusing on politics, economy, and Brazilian current events.

item.title: Os pontos fortes e fracos de Lula e Flávio nas redes sociais na véspera do segundo turno
item.description: Lula leads the IPDE with 55.6 points, excelling in digital reach and favorable sentiment after the debate, while Flávio Bolsonaro keeps higher engagement and follower growth. Despite the digital advantage, polls show a technical tie in voting intention.

item.title: Ao menos 139 mil eleitores têm o local de voto trocado no 2º turno
item.description: 139,207 voters had their polling locations changed between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections, affecting 442 sections in 22 states, according to TSE data. The Southeast region leads with 28.1% of cases, followed by the Northeast with 27.5%. Experts warn that these changes may increase voter abstention due to insecurity and misinformation among voters.

item.title: Nunes Marques recua e libera frota federal para levar indígenas
item.description: The President of the Brazilian Electoral Court, Kassio Nunes Marques, reversed his previous decision and allowed the use of federal vehicles and boats to transport indigenous people, quilombola communities, and traditional populations in the second round of elections, following pressure from the Attorney General's Office and a court ruling in Pará. Despite the relaxation, each transport operation still requires prior approval from the Electoral Court.

item.title: 442 seções eleitorais mudaram do 1º para o 2º turno; leia a lista
item.description: 442 polling stations were changed between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections, affecting 139,207 voters, according to TSE data. Changes occur due to logistical issues such as renovations, accessibility improvements, and weather conditions. Voters can check their polling location via the e-Título app, online self-service, or ChatVote.

item.title: Ato de Lula ocupa 14 quarteirões da avenida Paulista
item.description: President Lula held the campaign closing rally on Paulista Avenue, with at least 14 city blocks occupied and an estimated 2 million attendees according to the PT. The security team blocked high-resolution aerial footage, and Lula expressed concern about crowd density and people fainting.

item.title: Em live com Janones, Lula pede mobilização "até o último voto"
item.description: In a 24-hour livestream hosted by André Janones, Lula urged supporters to maintain their mobilization until the end of the second-round elections, highlighting the enthusiasm of the attendees. He thanked the protesters and emphasized the need to work until the last vote, expected on Tuesday.

item.title: Presença de eleitor nas urnas vira fator decisivo neste domingo após maior abstenção em 1º turno
item.description: The 2026 presidential runoff faces the highest abstention rate since 1998, with 21% of voters absent in the first round, making mobilization of non-voters a decisive factor. The campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro seek to attract the 33.7 million voters who did not vote, while student movements supporting the PT candidate organize street protests to increase participation. Analysts highlight factors such as apathy, protest, and mobility issues as reasons for low turnout.

item.title: Eleições 2026: 7 momentos da campanha de Lula à Presidência da República
item.description: Lula's 2026 presidential reelection campaign enters a tight runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro after a surprising first-round result. Despite unexpected support from figures like André Janones, the strategy focuses on rebuilding Flávio's image and building a broad coalition.

item.title: Da ordem para cancelar ‘dates’ à chegada do ‘marechal’: A rotina no ‘Exército do Lula’
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones leads the 'Exército do Lula' channel, which grew from 60,000 to 10 million followers in 17 days, mobilizing supporters through 'missions', including canceling romantic dates, while awaiting Lula's potential administration of the group. The strategy aims to organize voters after Mauro's defeat in the first round, though the channel was suspended twice by the TSE for electoral risks.

item.title: Brasil vai às urnas em clima de vale-tudo, com fratura exposta e briga acirrada entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: The presidential runoff campaign ends in intense polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with a technical tie in polls and high voter abstention. The scenario of fierce confrontation and mutual wear suggests a narrow victory for either candidate, with challenges in governing a divided country. Street protests and heated debates mark the closing of the most turbulent race since redemocratization.

item.title: Bastidores do STF: o que está em jogo para Moraes nas eleições deste domingo
item.description: The STF anxiously awaits the 2026 election results, as Minister Alexandre de Moraes' future directly depends on whether Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro wins. A Lula victory would be seen as salvation for Moraes, while a Flávio win could intensify impeachment pressures. Moraes has adopted an ambiguous strategy, combining conciliation with investigations that may impact the PL candidate.

item.title: Dilemas, futuro e o que move o eleitor: o capítulo final da disputa entre Lula e Flávio em análise
item.description: The presidential race between Lula and Flávio heads into the second round focused on public security, electoral justice, and corruption allegations. Despite tight polling, targeted strategies are essential to sway undecided voters and determine the winner.

item.title: Eleições 2026: 7 momentos da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro à Presidência da República
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads the 2026 presidential campaign with a slight edge over Lula (PT), according to polls, following his first-round victory and strong electoral performance by his party. The campaign was marked by euphoria, coalition-building with right-wing allies, and mobilization ahead of the October vote. While Bolsonarists trust in victory, PT supporters bet on polling trends.
